newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products - gas oil premiums rise, fuel dow.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - gas oil premiums rise, fuel dow.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Friday morning, with gas oil premiums rising as Rotterdam supply tightened, while fuel oil sagged, dealers said.

Heating oil barges were offered at IPE June +$3/$3.50 fob Rotterdam, more than $1 above Thursday's levels as majors sought to benefit from tighter suppliers of running refinery material. Buyers, however, were over $1 below the offer level. Futures were barely changed after opening gains.
High sulphur fuel oil traded in the range $83-$84 fob Rotterdam, $1 lower than at Thursday's close.
